thread.text:
Where each skill stands (pages against server/data/content, 2026-11-03):

**Far behind:** Ranged (no weapons, abilities or ammunition; tips in outline, calibration a proposal), Dreaming (nothing built; waits on the first way into the Dreaming), Tailoring (thinnest page; only four fishing-line recipes, no armour).

**Partly behind:** Artifice (13 recipes, all fishing gear; its ranged side waits on Ranged; the page's "Not built" is out of date, as is Tailoring's), Cooking (8 recipes, but no active layer), Occultism (combat done; reagents, rites and houses open).

**Ahead:** Melee, Smithing, Mining, Woodcutting, Fishing, Foraging, Medicine and Butchering mostly wait on the resources pass; Defence lacks only XP for damage prevented.

Suggestion: design Ranged, Artifice and Tailoring together as one pass.
